title: Остановка
prompt:
Design the BusNow stop page for «Молодёжная», a sibling of the home board, 390px wide, Russian UI, one column on the canvas. Same Golos Text, same colors, same card of departures. This page is where a signed-in person sets the stop and asks for a reminder. No marketing hero, no illustration.

Structure, top to bottom, page inset 24:
- Top bar: a text control «Назад» in muted 15px at the left, the word BusNow is not repeated as a second logo. 17px is reserved for the stop name below, not for a second wordmark.
- 32px below: «Молодёжная», 22px weight 600 ink. 8px under it, muted 14px «Подкастельцы → Гайдара».
- 24px below: two buttons side by side, height 44, radius 12, gap 8. «Это утро» is accent fill with white text and the raised shadow, because this stop is already the morning stop. «Это вечер» is a white surface, ink text, resting shadow.
- 24px below: the same white timetable card, radius 16, resting shadow, 1px dividers. Five rows, min-height 72, padding 16. Time 20px tabular weight 600. Bus badge is accent fill, white text, radius 8. Minibus badge is an ink outline, radius 8, with the word «маршрутка». Direction and day pattern are 14px muted, closer to the time than the next row is.
  - Past, all muted, no reminder: 07:05, badge «4», «Подкастельцы → Гайдара», «будни»
  - 07:22, badge «4А», same direction, «будни», and on the right a text button «Напомнить» in accent, 15px weight 600. The button's hit area is 44px tall. It is not a filled pill.
  - 07:40, outline badge «10Тк», «маршрутка», «Центр → Подкастельцы», «ежедневно», «Напомнить»
  - 07:55, badge «4», «Подкастельцы → Гайдара», «будни», «Напомнить»
  - 08:10, outline badge «2Тк», «маршрутка», «Молодёжная → Полимир», «будни», «Напомнить»
- 32px below the card: muted «Расписание может измениться.»
- 48px below: footer «Новополоцк», 13px muted.

Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, radius, shadows, and motion defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system. Keep Golos Text. Canvas #EFEFEC, surface #FFFFFF, ink #1C1C1A, muted #6B6B66, single accent #245C4A. No gradients, grain, blobs, script, or a second accent.
